sim.title: Live routing
sim.lede: An inbound lead is filtered by licence, geography, capacity and language, then assigned by fair rotation. If nobody responds before the deadline, it escalates automatically.
sim.speedHint: Compresses the real {sla}s SLA for demonstration
sim.emptyHint: Trigger a lead to watch the routing decision resolve, second by second.

hold.title: Hold queue
hold.empty: Empty — every lead found an owner

jur.title: Jurisdiction manager
jur.lede: Every jurisdiction is data, not code. Add a market here and the routing engine uses it immediately — with no deploy.
jur.name: Name

attr.title: Attribution — ad click to closing
attr.lede: The ad click is carried all the way to the closing, so cost per closed sale is calculated rather than estimated.
attr.journeyHint: Route a lead, have it accepted, then close the transaction. Its full journey appears here — carrying its own click id.

tour.inviteBody: Let me show you around. I'll drive, you watch — and you can take over whenever you like.
tour.pausedNote: Paused — the console is yours. Resume whenever you want.

market.title: Quebec, in French by default
market.body: This page loaded in French before any interaction. Commission, stages, terminology and legal disclosures all come from this market's record.

route.title: A lead arrives
route.body: I'm triggering a lead in Laval. Watch the decision log underneath.

decision-log.title: The decision, line by line
decision-log.body: Licence, geography, capacity, language — then fair rotation. The capacity line drops Isabelle Bouchard, already at 12/12. Decided in under a millisecond.

assigned.title: Marie-Claude has it
assigned.body: Fair rotation picked the least recently assigned broker. SMS and push go out immediately.

countdown.title: She has 60 seconds
countdown.body: The window is compressed for the demo. She will not respond — watch what happens when it expires.

escalated.title: It escalated on its own
escalated.body: With no response the lead reassigned itself to Simon Gagnon. No human involved, no lead rotting in an inbox.

accept.title: Simon accepts
accept.body: I'm accepting on his behalf. In the real product this is a button in his portal, or an SMS reply.

load.title: His load just changed
load.body: One more active file against his cap. The next lead routes differently — capacity is not decoration.

close.title: From file to closing
close.body: The stages come from the market's configuration. Quebec closes at the notary; Ontario waives conditions.

unroutable.title: And when nobody is available?
unroutable.body: I filled the only broker covering Gatineau, then sent a lead there. No eligible broker left.

hold-explained.title: The lead is not lost
hold-explained.body: It drops into the hold queue and an administrator is alerted. The cap protected the broker instead of quietly burying them.

override.title: Manual override
override.body: An administrator can push past the cap. Licence and territory stay non-negotiable — a full desk is a human judgement call.

jurisdictions.title: Opening a new market
jurisdictions.body: This is the jurisdiction manager. I'm opening the form — pre-filled with Florida.

create-market.title: Creating Florida
create-market.body: Currency, commission, language, stages — all from the form. No code, no deploy.

market-created.title: The market exists
market-created.body: The interface switched to English and the currency to US dollars. The routing engine is already using it.

attribution.title: Cost per closing moved
attribution.body: The lead you watched close carried its campaign the whole way. The calculation is real; the ad-spend figures are sample data — wiring them to Google Ads and Meta is configuration, not a rebuild.

done.title: That's the engine
done.body: Routing, escalation, capacity caps, override, configurable markets and attribution — all in the browser with no database. The code is in your repository.
